summary: The parent incorrectly rejects valid mixed-type TOML arrays. The fix removes element-type checks and mixed-array errors, allowing heterogeneous values. Blocked: no buildable single-file verbatim reversal was established. Restoring src/parser/array.rs requires deleted types and methods from src/value.rs and src/parser/errors.rs; restoring src/value.rs changes push_formatted back to Result, incompatible with the unchanged parser's loop body. The fix enables mixed-array cases through the custom decoder_compliance harness, but no detecting Rust test function name was established. Existing parser::tests::arrays and test_arrays_hetergeneous only exercise arrays whose immediate elements share a type. No builds or tests were executed.
